CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.creator_is_trusted(p_creator uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce((select xp from public.creators where id = p_creator), 0) >= 2000
     and exists (
       select 1 from public.creator_social_accounts
       where creator_id = p_creator and owner_verified
     );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_valid_public_http_url(value text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select value ~* '^https?://((([a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?\.)+[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?)|(\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3}))(?::\d{1,5})?(?:[/?#][^\s]*)?$';
$function$

functions.name: is_valid_public_profile_highlights
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_valid_public_profile_highlights(value jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select
    jsonb_typeof(value) = 'array'
    and jsonb_array_length(value) <= 3
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from jsonb_array_elements(value) as elem
      where jsonb_typeof(elem) <> 'object'
        or not (
          elem ? 'url'
          and elem ? 'title'
          and elem ? 'platform_type'
          and elem ? 'caption'
          and elem ? 'sort_order'
        )
        or exists (
          select 1
          from jsonb_object_keys(elem) as key_name
          where key_name not in ('url', 'title', 'platform_type', 'caption', 'sort_order')
        )
        or jsonb_typeof(elem -> 'url') <> 'string'
        or not private.is_valid_public_http_url(elem ->> 'url')
        or jsonb_typeof(elem -> 'title') <> 'string'
        or btrim(elem ->> 'title') = ''
        or jsonb_typeof(elem -> 'platform_type') <> 'string'
        or (elem ->> 'platform_type') not in (
          'instagram',
          'threads',
          'tiktok',
          'youtube',
          'website',
          'case_study',
          'other'
        )
        or coalesce(jsonb_typeof(elem -> 'caption'), 'null') not in ('string', 'null')
        or jsonb_typeof(elem -> 'sort_order') <> 'number'
        or ((elem ->> 'sort_order')::numeric % 1) <> 0
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.uuid_lock_key(value uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select
    ((get_byte(uuid_send(value), 0)::int << 24)
      | (get_byte(uuid_send(value), 1)::int << 16)
      | (get_byte(uuid_send(value), 2)::int << 8)
      | get_byte(uuid_send(value), 3)::int)
    # ((get_byte(uuid_send(value), 4)::int << 24)
      | (get_byte(uuid_send(value), 5)::int << 16)
      | (get_byte(uuid_send(value), 6)::int << 8)
      | get_byte(uuid_send(value), 7)::int)
    # ((get_byte(uuid_send(value), 8)::int << 24)
      | (get_byte(uuid_send(value), 9)::int << 16)
      | (get_byte(uuid_send(value), 10)::int << 8)
      | get_byte(uuid_send(value), 11)::int)
    # ((get_byte(uuid_send(value), 12)::int << 24)
      | (get_byte(uuid_send(value), 13)::int << 16)
      | (get_byte(uuid_send(value), 14)::int << 8)
      | get_byte(uuid_send(value), 15)::int);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.broadcast_campaign_started(p_campaign uuid, p_creator_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare v_ws uuid; v_title text; v_slug text; v_n int;
begin
  select workspace_id, title, slug into v_ws, v_title, v_slug
    from public.campaigns where id = p_campaign;
  if v_ws is null then return 0; end if;

  insert into public.notifications (user_id, workspace_id, type, entity_type, entity_id, data)
  select cid, v_ws, 'campaign_started', 'campaign', p_campaign,
         jsonb_build_object('campaign_title', coalesce(v_title,''), 'campaign_slug', coalesce(v_slug,''))
    from unnest(p_creator_ids) as cid
   where not exists (
     select 1 from public.notifications n
      where n.user_id = cid and n.type = 'campaign_started' and n.entity_id = p_campaign);
  get diagnostics v_n = row_count;
  return v_n;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.level_for_xp(p_xp integer)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select case
    when coalesce(p_xp, 0) >= 100000 then 'L6'
    when coalesce(p_xp, 0) >=  40000 then 'L5'
    when coalesce(p_xp, 0) >=  15000 then 'L4'
    when coalesce(p_xp, 0) >=   6000 then 'L3'
    when coalesce(p_xp, 0) >=   2000 then 'L2'
    when coalesce(p_xp, 0) >=    500 then 'L1'
    else 'L0'
  end
$function$

functions.name: match_kb_chunks
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.match_kb_chunks(query_embedding vector, match_count integer DEFAULT 5, filter_locale text DEFAULT 'zh-HK'::text, filter_workspace text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(chunk_id uuid, document_id uuid, title text, source_type text, source_ref text, content text, similarity double precision)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select c.id, c.document_id, d.title, d.source_type, d.source_ref, c.content,
         1 - (c.embedding <=> query_embedding) as similarity
  from public.kb_chunks c
  join public.kb_documents d on d.id = c.document_id
  where d.locale = filter_locale
    and (d.workspace is null or d.workspace = filter_workspace)
  order by c.embedding <=> query_embedding
  limit match_count;
$function$
functions.identityArguments: query_embedding vector, match_count integer, filter_locale text, filter_workspace text

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rank_campaign(p_campaign uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(creator_id uuid, rank integer, approved bigint, avg_quality numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  with cfg as (
    select id, workspace_id, starts_at, ends_at
      from public.campaigns where id = p_campaign
  ),
  counted as (
    select s.creator_id,
           count(*) as approved,
           coalesce(avg(s.quality_rating) filter (where s.quality_rating is not null), 0) as avg_quality
      from public.mission_submissions s
      join cfg on s.workspace_id = cfg.workspace_id
      join public.campaign_missions cm
        on cm.campaign_id = cfg.id
       and cm.mission_id  = s.mission_id
       and cm.added_at   <= s.reviewed_at
       and (cm.removed_at is null or s.reviewed_at < cm.removed_at)
     where s.status = 'approved'
       and s.submitted_at >= cfg.starts_at
       and s.submitted_at <  cfg.ends_at
     group by s.creator_id
  )
  select c.creator_id,
         row_number() over (
           order by c.approved desc,
                    c.avg_quality desc,
                    p.goal_reached_at asc nulls last,
                    c.creator_id asc
         )::int as rank,
         c.approved,
         c.avg_quality
    from counted c
    left join public.campaign_participants p
      on p.campaign_id = p_campaign and p.creator_id = c.creator_id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_workspace_budget_enforcement(p_workspace uuid, p_enforced boolean)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.workspace_budgets (workspace_id, enforced) values (p_workspace, p_enforced)
    on conflict (workspace_id) do update set enforced = excluded.enforced, updated_at = now();
  return p_enforced;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.snapshot_campaign_leaderboards()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare v_n int;
begin
  insert into public.campaign_rank_snapshots (campaign_id, workspace_id, creator_id, rank, approved, captured_at)
  select c.id, c.workspace_id, r.creator_id, r.rank, r.approved, now()
    from public.campaigns c
    cross join lateral public.rank_campaign(c.id) r
   where c.status = 'active';
  get diagnostics v_n = row_count;
  return v_n;
end $function$
